label: prop:bring-residue-resolvent
title: Bring residue → canonical resolvent form 1/(1 − h_q · q^{α_shift})
html:
The substrate evaluation of the residue / Schwarz integral on Bring's surface around the simple pole of order n of \sigma on the torus knot T(p, k) with \alpha_{\text{shift}}(p, k) = n yields the canonical resolvent form

  F_n(q) = \frac{1}{1 - h_q \cdot q^n}, \qquad h_q = q - q^{-1},

the shared closed-form derivation across the α_shift universal chain's specialisations.

The scaffolded open math, the Lean structure, the class-instance closure, and the downstream consequence are collected in the Bring-residue resolvent context.
